description: Prepare the Bell state (|00> + |11>)/sqrt(2) and measure both qubits.
prompt: Write a Python function named build_circuit() that takes no arguments and returns a qiskit QuantumCircuit with exactly 2 qubits. The circuit must prepare the Bell state (|00> + |11>)/sqrt(2) starting from |00>, then measure both qubits into classical bits. Use only the qiskit package. Return the circuit; do not run it. Answer with the code only.
